# Read the client contract before it reads you.

> Free freelance contract checker: paste the client agreement or statement of work and see the red flags before you sign, such as net 60 payment, unlimited revisions, IP assigned before you are paid, non-compete, uncapped indemnity, or no kill fee. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
